specs.title: Calendar view
specs.why: The calendar is the owner's primary daily surface for seeing and moving work.
specs.scope: Day and week calendar views at `/app/calendar`. Click a booking to edit. Drag to reschedule. Persist the reschedule and emit an audit log entry.
tasks: Day view and week view components
acceptance: Drag rescheduling persists and updates the UI optimistically
An invalid drag (overlap or outside hours) reverts with a toast
The audit log records both old and new time

specs.title: Clients CRM
specs.why: Repeat business is the core value for these merchants, which requires client history in one place.
specs.scope: `/app/clients` list with search by name or phone. Client profile shows booking history, lifetime value, no-show count, tags and notes.
tasks: Client list with server-side search and pagination
Compute lifetime value from confirmed payments
acceptance: Search returns matches within 300ms over 10k clients
The profile shows every past booking
Tags persist and filter the list

specs.title: Tenant settings
specs.why: Branding and locale settings are prerequisites for the public page and payments.
specs.scope: Settings page for business name, slug, timezone (default `Africa/Lagos`), currency (default `NGN`), logo upload, brand colour and cancellation policy text.
specs.non_goals: If object-storage credentials are unavailable, implement the storage port with a local-filesystem adapter and leave the S3 adapter behind the same interface.
tasks: Logo upload to S3-compatible object storage
Colour picker with a contrast check
acceptance: Changing the slug updates the public URL
Logo and colour are reflected on the public booking page
A duplicate slug is rejected with a helpful error
